data_analyst.name: Data Analyst
data_analyst.description: Examines, cleans, transforms, and models data to discover useful information, suggest conclusions, and support business decision-making.

Python.description: Automate data workflows, manipulate dataframes using Pandas/NumPy, and perform exploratory data analysis (EDA).
Python.recommendation: Master Pandas, NumPy, and data wrangling techniques. Practice analyzing real-world CSV/JSON datasets on Kaggle.

SQL.description: Write complex relational queries using SELECT, JOINs, aggregations, window functions, and CTEs to extract raw business data.
SQL.recommendation: Improve SQL fundamentals: practice multi-table JOINs, GROUP BY, HAVING, subqueries, and window functions (RANK, ROW_NUMBER) on LeetCode/HackerRank.

Excel.description: Utilize advanced formulas (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH), Pivot Tables, Power Query, and basic VBA for rapid tabular modeling.
Excel.recommendation: Advance from basic arithmetic to nested formulas, Pivot Tables, Power Query transformations, and interactive dashboard creation.

Statistics.description: Understand descriptive metrics (mean, median, variance), hypothesis testing, p-values, distributions, and correlation vs causation.
Statistics.recommendation: Study probability distributions, A/B testing concepts, central limit theorem, and confidence intervals through practical case studies.

Data Visualization.description: Communicate patterns effectively through charts using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and sound visual hierarchy design principles.
Data Visualization.recommendation: Build visual stories using bar, scatter, box, and heat maps; avoid deceptive charts and practice presenting data insights clearly.

Power BI.description: Build interactive executive dashboards, configure star-schema data models, and write fundamental DAX measures.
Power BI.recommendation: Learn Power Query ETL in Power BI Desktop, basic DAX expressions (CALCULATE, RELATED, SUMX), and publish scheduled reports.

web_developer.name: Web Developer
web_developer.description: Designs and builds responsive client-side user interfaces and robust server-side APIs to deliver modern web applications.

HTML.description: Semantic markup, accessibility (ARIA), SEO meta structure, and modern HTML5 document layout.
HTML.recommendation: Focus on semantic HTML5 tags (nav, main, section, article), form validations, accessibility compliance, and structural SEO.

CSS.description: Modern CSS layouts with Flexbox and CSS Grid, transitions, animations, CSS variables, and clean styling architecture.
CSS.recommendation: Strengthen CSS Grid, Flexbox alignment, BEM methodology, CSS variables, and fluid typography techniques.

JavaScript.description: ES6+ syntax, asynchronous programming (Promises, async/await), DOM manipulation, Fetch API, and closures.
JavaScript.recommendation: Master ES6+ features (destructuring, arrow functions), Event Loop, DOM manipulation, and asynchronous API integration.

Git.description: Version control workflows, branching, commits, merging, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts.
Git.recommendation: Practice daily terminal Git commands: branching (`git checkout -b`), stashing, rebasing, and collaborating via GitHub pull requests.

Responsive Design.description: Mobile-first layouts, CSS media queries, responsive images (srcset), and cross-device testing.
Responsive Design.recommendation: Adopt a mobile-first development approach, test viewport breakpoints using browser DevTools, and implement fluid layouts.

Backend Basics.description: Understanding HTTP verbs, RESTful routing, server-side sessions, request-response lifecycles, and API design.
Backend Basics.recommendation: Build lightweight REST API endpoints using Python (Flask/FastAPI) or Node.js/Express, handling JSON requests and status codes.

software_developer.name: Software Developer
software_developer.description: Architects, writes, tests, and maintains reliable, scalable computer software and backend application logic.

Data Structures & Algorithms.description: Arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, sorting, searching, hashing, and asymptotic Big-O time/space complexity analysis.
Data Structures & Algorithms.recommendation: Solve standard DSA problems systematically on arrays, strings, trees, and graphs. Focus on explaining time and space complexity.

Python or Java.description: Deep syntax command, standard library fluency, memory model, concurrency primitives, and unit testing frameworks.
Python or Java.recommendation: Deepen language mastery: learn memory management, exceptions, standard library collections, and write unit tests with pytest/JUnit.

Object-Oriented Programming.description: Encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, and clean software architecture (SOLID principles).
Object-Oriented Programming.recommendation: Implement SOLID principles in small projects, write clean modular classes, and avoid tight coupling between business logic and UI.

Git & Version Control.description: Collaborative branching strategies (Git Flow), atomic commits, code review etiquettes, and conflict resolution.
Git & Version Control.recommendation: Adopt conventional commit messages, create feature branches, and practice squash rebasing and interactive Git operations.

Database Management.description: Relational schema design, ACID transactions, primary/foreign keys, normalization (1NF-3NF), and basic indexing.
Database Management.recommendation: Design normalized database schemas, write transactional SQL, and analyze query execution plans with EXPLAIN.

System Design Basics.description: Client-server architecture, caching strategies, load balancing concepts, horizontal vs vertical scaling, and microservices.
System Design Basics.recommendation: Study high-level components of web architectures: DNS, CDN, load balancers, caching (Redis), and stateless backend servers.

ai_ml_engineer.name: AI/ML Engineer
ai_ml_engineer.description: Designs, trains, evaluates, and deploys predictive machine learning models and deep neural networks to solve complex problems.

Python.description: Expert fluency in Python, vectorization with NumPy, Pandas pipelines, performance profiling, and modular package structure.
Python.recommendation: Develop expert Python fluency: vectorized tensor computations, clean OOP for pipeline modules, profiling, and efficient data processing.

Mathematics & Linear Algebra.description: Vector spaces, matrix multiplication, eigenvalues/eigenvectors, multivariable calculus (gradients/backpropagation), and probability theory.
Mathematics & Linear Algebra.recommendation: Review linear algebra (eigenvalues, dot products, matrix decompositions) and multivariable calculus (partial derivatives, gradient descent).

Machine Learning Algorithms.description: Supervised & unsupervised algorithms: Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and K-Means.
Machine Learning Algorithms.recommendation: Implement classical ML algorithms using Scikit-Learn; understand the bias-variance tradeoff, regularization (L1/L2), and hyperparameter tuning.
resources: Hands-On ML with Scikit-Learn and TensorFlow

Deep Learning.description: Multi-Layer Perceptrons, activation functions (ReLU, Softmax), backpropagation, CNNs for computer vision, and Transformer basics in PyTorch.
Deep Learning.recommendation: Build foundational neural nets using PyTorch or TensorFlow; learn loss functions, optimizers (Adam), and training validation loops.

Data Preprocessing.description: Handling missing data, one-hot/ordinal encoding, feature scaling (StandardScaler/MinMax), feature engineering, and outlier detection.
Data Preprocessing.recommendation: Construct robust Scikit-Learn Pipelines with ColumnTransformers to prevent data leakage between train and test splits.

Model Evaluation.description: Confusion matrix, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, ROC-AUC curve, cross-validation, and detecting overfitting vs underfitting.
Model Evaluation.recommendation: Master evaluation metrics beyond simple accuracy: analyze Precision-Recall curves, confusion matrices, and k-fold cross-validation.
resources: Google ML Crash Course - Classification Metrics

cybersecurity_analyst.name: Cybersecurity Analyst
cybersecurity_analyst.description: Monitors networks, identifies vulnerabilities, investigates security breaches, and implements proactive defensive countermeasures.

Network Security.description: OSI & TCP/IP models, packet inspection, firewalls, subnets, VPNs, DNS security, and Wireshark traffic analysis.
Network Security.recommendation: Study packet analysis with Wireshark, understand TCP handshakes, subnetting, common port protocols, and firewall rulesets.

Linux & Operating Systems.description: Bash shell scripting, file permissions (chmod/chown), process management, system logging (/var/log), and kernel basics.
Linux & Operating Systems.recommendation: Gain solid Linux terminal proficiency: navigate filesystem, inspect auth logs, manage user groups, and write defensive Bash scripts.
resources: Linux Command Line by William Shotts

Cryptography Basics.description: Symmetric vs asymmetric encryption (AES, RSA), hashing algorithms (SHA-256), digital certificates (PKI), and SSL/TLS handshakes.
Cryptography Basics.recommendation: Learn core cryptographic primitives: hashing vs encryption vs encoding, public key infrastructure, and SSL certificate chains.

Vulnerability Assessment.description: Scanning tools (Nmap, OpenVAS/Nessus), identifying OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities, CVE analysis, and CVSS scoring.
Vulnerability Assessment.recommendation: Practice scanning local lab environments with Nmap, research CVE databases, and study the OWASP Top 10 web security risks.

Threat Intelligence & SIEM.description: Log correlation, detecting anomaly signatures, MITRE ATT&CK framework, and tools like Splunk or ELK stack.
Threat Intelligence & SIEM.recommendation: Explore log analysis and alerting using Splunk or Elastic SIEM; map adversary techniques to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

Security Protocols.description: Enforcing secure communication protocols: HTTPS, SSH, SFTP, IPsec, DNSSEC, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and zero trust.
Security Protocols.recommendation: Understand implementation details of secure communication standards, SSH key hardening, and modern IAM/MFA architectures.

1.label: Beginner
1.summary: Familiar with terminology but has minimal hands-on experience; requires close guidance.

2.label: Basic
2.summary: Understands core concepts and can execute simple tasks following step-by-step instructions.

3.label: Intermediate
3.summary: Can solve standard problems independently; comfortable with common tools and workflows.

4.label: Advanced
4.summary: Possesses in-depth practical knowledge, can handle complex scenarios, and produces optimized solutions.

5.label: Expert
5.summary: Comprehensive authority; can architect end-to-end systems, troubleshoot deep anomalies, and mentor others.
